corrections.previous_claim: The earlier C-Q3-R1 record stated that the source panel was empty.
corrections.corrected_claim: The original DOM already recorded a count of 97 web pages and 6 visible links, plus a control to show another 91 (original UI: \u663e\u793a\u53e6\u591691\u4e2a). All 97 retrieved sources were saved separately during recovery. The retrieval list and answer citations are recorded separately.

corrections.previous_claim: Earlier notes treated an empty or short read_thread result, cross-checked against the web page, as confirmation that no answer text had been returned.
corrections.corrected_claim: The existing exports establish that the capture was empty or incomplete at the time; they cannot independently establish that the server lacked a complete answer. The share preview of the same C-Q3-R1 conversation exposed answer text and links, showing that at least this main-page loading failure was related to the capture channel. The causes of other cases must still be assessed from their respective evidence.

corrections.previous_claim: Opening new conversations controlled only within-conversation follow-ups; account memory was treated merely as a general limitation.
corrections.corrected_claim: Memory sources in the original C-Q3-R1 DOM actually included an earlier Q1 conversation from this experiment and user background. This is observable cross-test memory influence; the 12 tests cannot be described as fully independent.

corrections.previous_claim: C-Q1-R1 had previously been counted as completed.
corrections.corrected_claim: The share preview retained 9 resource links, but the two-week plan stopped at Days 4–6. Completeness of the full answer could not be verified, so it is now classified as partial and excluded from complete-sample statistics.

corrections.previous_claim: Additional queries could directly resolve the blank and truncated answer issues.
corrections.corrected_claim: The third attempt under the same conditions, C-Q2-R1-A3, indicated that the answer had completed and 21 websites had been searched, but the main page could not load it. The share preview contained only 2417 characters and 2 direct links, ending within the second study. The capture method had been corrected, but the platform failure had not been resolved; its underlying cause remained unknown.

corrections.previous_claim: The report still showed 7/12 complete answers and stated that no additional attempts had used a different model.
corrections.corrected_claim: Cursor had submitted 4 additional test conversations: 3 with completed raw captures and 1 awaiting recovery. After the existing answers were recovered and reviewed on October 30 and 1 new Q3 conversation was added, all 12 slots had complete main answers. The actual model records still showed GPT-6. The 5 supplemental slots used Medium reasoning effort, unlike the earlier Extra High setting. Each record follows the actual evidence rather than the proposed model.
